name: KELT-3
description: Star of 6,304 K, 210 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: KELT-3 b crosses KELT-3 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: KELT-3
quotes.card: KELT-3 is a star in the zodiac constellation Leo Minor.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent magnitude of 9.82, it is too faint to be seen with the naked eye, but can be detected using a telescope.
